problem: Energy release for periodic cracks in a prestressed elastic film on a Winkler foundation
units_note: normalized (dimensionless) quantities; ell = sqrt(h Ebar/k), Ebar = E/(1-nu^2); gamma = G Ebar/(sigma0^2 ell); kI = KI/(sigma0 sqrt(ell)); nu = 0.3 for kI values

checks.name: sympy_symbolic_verification
checks.description: wake ODE residual=0; BC sigma22=0 at both strip edges; strip energy integral W(S) = -h s0^2 ell tanh(S/2ell)/Ebar (exact + 4-point numeric); linear/quadratic decomposition -2:+1; identity 2tanh x - tanh 2x = 2t^3/(1+t^2)

checks.name: gamma_B_two_forms_consistency
checks.description: 2 tanh(x) - tanh(2x) vs 2 t^3/(1+t^2) at the four sampling points

checks.name: finite_difference_J_integral
checks.description: independent 2D FD solution on symmetry half-domain; G = (2/h) DJ from path-independent Eshelby line integrals; 5 configurations
checks.output: case A H=1.0: rel_err -0.01%; case A H=2.0: rel_err -0.02%; case A H=0.5: rel_err -0.00%; case B H=1.0: rel_err -0.06%; case B H=2.0: rel_err -0.13%; grid-convergence ratio 3.93 (expect ~4 for 2nd order)

checks.name: asymptotic_limits
checks.description: gamma_A/x -> 1 and gamma_B/(2x^3) -> 1 as x=H/2ell -> 0; gamma_A, gamma_B -> 1 as x -> infinity
checks.tolerance: ratios -> 1 within 1e-4 at x=1e-3; big-x within 1e-15
